item.title: 🎙 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during a meeting with President of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev
item.description: 🎙 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during a meeting with President of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev (Moscow, November 25, 2026) 💬 Vladimir Putin: I am very pleased to see you. We meet regularly – in Kazakhstan , in Russia and on the sidelines of various international events. This time, you have agreed to come to Russia as the guest of honour at the conference on artificial intelligence organised by Sberbank. I know that you devote considerable attention to the development of information technology in Kazakhstan . I am sure you will find the conference interesting. We will have an opportunity to hear from experts, interact with young people – schoolchildren and university students – and discuss cooperation between Russia and Kazakhstan in high-tech industries in general and in artificial intelligence in particular. 📈 Our bilateral trade is growing at a steady pace and is already approaching $30 billion – just over $28 billion, I believe. Settlements are conducted in national currencies, and their share is already substantial – over 90%. The Intergovernmental Commission is working actively on both sides. Overall, everything is progressing at a good pace , and our cooperation is at a good level . 🤝 I believe our regular meetings also help create a favourable atmosphere and give momentum to this entire process , so we are very pleased to see you. 🇷🇺 🇰🇿 #RussiaKazakhstan

item.title: 🇷🇺 November 25 marks the 6️⃣ 6️⃣ th Anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between our country and the Federal Republic of Nigeria.
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇳🇬 November 25 marks the 6️⃣ 6️⃣ th Anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between our country and the Federal Republic of Nigeria. On October 1, 1960, the Nigerian people cast off the shackles of British colonial rule . The Soviet Union was among the first countries to establish diplomatic relations with the newly independent African state. The Soviet Union provided Nigeria with substantial assistance and support in building its national institutions, strengthening socio-economic stability and assisting the transition from an agrarian and resource-dependent territory to one of Africa's largest and self-reliant economies. 🤝 #Nigeria is one of the key partners of the Russian Federation. 🇷🇺
🇳🇬
November 25 marks the
6️⃣
6️⃣
th Anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between our country and the Federal Republic of Nigeria.
On October 1, 1960,
the Nigerian people cast off the shackles of British colonial rule
. The Soviet Union was among the first countries to establish diplomatic relations with the newly independent African state.
The Soviet Union provided Nigeria with
substantial assistance and support
in building its national institutions, strengthening socio-economic stability and
assisting
the transition
from an agrarian and resource-dependent territory to one of Africa's largest and self-reliant economies.
🤝
#Nigeria
is one of the key partners of the Russian Federation.
Today, our countries continue to steadily expand cooperation in the political, trade and economic, humanitarian and other fields. Russian-Nigerian relations have traditionally been
friendly in nature
and continue to develop on the basis of
equality
,
mutual
respect
and consideration for each other's interests.
Both countries expand business contacts and implement
joint projects
in the fields of energy, mineral extraction and processing, agriculture, construction, and infrastructure development and modernisation. The
Intergovernmental Commission on Trade and Economic Cooperation
continues to operate on a regular basis.
🌐
#MultipolarWorld
: Our countries are committed to promoting the emergence of a more
just and democratic world order
— the tendency reflecting the steady increase in the economic, financial and political weight of the countries of the
#GlobalSouth
and the
#GlobalEast
in the international arena. Moscow and Abuja share the conviction that it is essential to
overcome the remnants of neo-colonial practices
in interstate relations.
Russia supported
Nigeria's application for BRICS partner country status
. Nigeria has held this status since January 1, 2025, and actively participates in a wide range of events organised by the Association.
Cooperation in the
humanitarian field
is also being stepped up. Russia has increased the number of
scholarships awarded to Nigerian students annually
. A total of 220 scholarships have been allocated for the current academic year.
💬
Russian Foreign Minister
Sergey Lavrov
,
following talks
with
Yusuf Tuggar
, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, in Moscow
(March 6, 2024)
:
In the new historical circumstances, when the countries of the Global South and East, the countries of the
#WorldMajority
, <...> are beginning to assert their interests on the international stage, we have
even more common ground and converging approaches
in favour of eliminating injustice in international relations and establishing an equitable balance of interests therein, in full accordance with the principles of the
#UNCharter
.
🎉
We extend our congratulations to our Nigerian colleagues and friends on our shared occasion — the
6️⃣
6️⃣
th Anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between our countries. We wish them good health, well-being and prosperity!
#RussiaNigeria
#RussiaAfrica

🎙
Excerpts from Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov’s
answers to media questions
following the joint meeting of the boards of the Russian and Belarusian Foreign Ministries
(Gomel, November 25, 2026)
❓
Question: The European Commission
has refused
to hold bilateral consultations with Russia on European security. Prior to that, Europe spent a long time discussing who should be appointed as its negotiator. How can this contradictory position be explained?
💬
Sergey Lavrov:
We have never had any contacts with the European Commission regarding negotiations on the Ukraine crisis. The European Commission regularly makes
various statements
.
However, the fact that these are
not accompanied by any concrete proposals
conveyed to the Russian Side through diplomatic channels confirms
the lack of seriousness in the approach taken by Brussels
,
particularly by the European Commission, which engages in megaphone diplomacy.
There have been some interesting statements. Polish Prime Minister
Donald Tusk
said
that
no one intended to consult Russia
on what the European dimension of the upcoming negotiations should look like.
EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy
Kaja Kallas
still holds her post, so
her statement
must also be taken into account. She said that
Europe already had a security architecture
– NATO and the EU – and that no one should try to reshape it. The main objective, she said, was
to integrate Ukraine into NATO and the EU
. She also added that
the EU must not allow a settlement that takes Russia’s interests into account.
👉
So we know full well what the position voiced by the Europeans is worth.
There has recently been discussion of
statements
coming out of Brussels
claiming that they had agreed on a negotiating team
(they had been asked about their negotiator) – the European "Five" (meaning France, Germany, Britain, Italy and Poland, plus representatives of the EU and NATO). That makes
seven
already.
They publicly stated that
this "Seven" should insert itself
into
the negotiation process that has now resumed in Abu Dhab
i involving Russia, the US and Ukraine.
☝️
Our position is that we must first understand what role Europe intends to play in the negotiations and what objectives, if any, it has set for itself.
If those objectives are reflected in the statements I have just quoted – that NATO and the EU alone will shape Europe’s security architecture and that Russia’s interests must not be accommodated –
then what is the point of holding such negotiations?
We therefore asked representatives of European countries
to come and see us or convey their position to us in some other way
. They say:
"No, we do not want to explain anything to you. We want to sit down at the negotiating table straight away"
.
With such manners and intentions,
they will sit down at the negotiating table only to immediately put their feet up on it.
❌
We have no need for that.

item.title: 🇷🇺 International Festival of the Russian Language and Culture Underway in Islamabad
item.description: 🇷🇺 📚 International Festival of the Russian Language and Culture Underway in Islamabad On November 23, the International Festival of the Russian Language kicked off at Allama Iqbal Open University (AIOU), with the support of Ural State Pedagogical University (USPU) and the Embassy of Russia in Pakistan. 🎓 The opening ceremony was attended by representatives of AIOU and USPU, as well as Gleb Shubin, Cultural Attaché of the Russian Embassy , Roman Porozov and Anton Dolgov, faculty members of the Russian university. 🇷🇺 🤝 🇵🇰 Speakers highlighted the importance of cultural and educational initiatives in strengthening humanitarian ties between Russia and Pakistan. 📖 The first day of the festival was dedicated to the Russian language and its history. International Festival of the Russian Language and Culture Underway in Islamabad
On November 23, the International Festival of the Russian Language kicked off at Allama Iqbal Open University (AIOU), with the support of Ural State Pedagogical University (USPU) and the Embassy of Russia in Pakistan.
🎓
The opening ceremony was attended by representatives of AIOU and USPU, as well as
Gleb Shubin, Cultural Attaché of the Russian Embassy
,
Roman Porozov and Anton Dolgov,
faculty members of the Russian university.
🇷🇺
🤝
🇵🇰
Speakers highlighted the importance of cultural and educational initiatives in strengthening humanitarian ties between Russia and Pakistan.
📖
The first day of the festival was dedicated to the Russian language and its history.
USPU Associate Professor
Svetlana Eremina
delivered a lecture on linguistic contacts and borrowing among the peoples of Russia. She also highlighted similarities between certain Russian and Urdu words, including those related to culinary traditions.
The event also featured remarks by USPU administrators and faculty members, including
Acting Rector Margarita Kusova,
Director of the Institute of Philology and Intercultural Communication
Irina Semukhina
,
Professor Natalia Zavyalova
, and other university representatives.
🎭
The first day concluded with a lecture by Pakistani Professor Dr. Abdul Aziz Sahir titled
“Pushkin and Iqbal: A Dialogue Between Two National Poets.”
His presentation explored the literary legacies of the two great poets and their contributions to promoting humanist principles and values.
🎨
On the second day, USPU faculty members Roman Porozov and Anton Dolgov conducted a workshop titled
“The Richness of Russian Culture”
for primary school students at the Russian Open Education Center at AIOU.
The children learned about traditional Russian ornamental patterns and had the opportunity to try their hand at decorative arts and crafts.
🌐
The festival will continue through November 26, with events taking place at Allama Iqbal Open University and the Federal Urdu University of Arts, Science and Technology.
#RussiaPakistan

item.title: 🇷🇺 On 23 November, the Russia–India Forum on Best Practices in Healthcare and Social Welfare
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇮🇳 On 23 November, the Russia–India Forum on Best Practices in Healthcare and Social Welfare was held in New Delhi, organised by the Department for External Economic and International Relations of Moscow and the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI). 🤝 The Russian delegation shared its experience in modernising the urban healthcare system, introducing digital solutions and improving the management of medical institutions. Indian focuses on practices in the development of specialised medicine, diagnostics and the introduction of medical technologies in the country. The welcoming address was delivered by Trade Representative of Russia in India Andrey Sobolev . 🎤 More than 20 participants addressed the plenary session. The key speakers included Deputy Heads of the Department of Health of Moscow Konstantin Pokrovsky and Nikolay Rubtsov , Director of the Center for the Implementation of Modern Technologies for Managing Medical Organisations of Moscow Olga Sokolovskaya, Director of the Center for Monitoring and Development of Medical Care of Moscow Igor Vlasov, Joint Secretary of the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India Sibin C. and President of the Global Coalition Against TB, President of the Policymakers Forum for Mental Health Dalbir Singh . The event brought together representatives of leading Russian and Indian medical institutions, experts and journalists. #Medicine #RussiaIndia #Druzh
